title: OTECH SC-SC 10M Single-Mode Fiber Patch Cord

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The OTECH SC-SC 10M Single-Mode Fiber Patch Cord is designed to deliver high-speed, long-distance optical data transmission with exceptional stability. Built with 9/125µm single-mode fiber and high-quality SC connectors, this 10-meter patch cord ensures ultra-low insertion loss, strong durability, and consistent network performance for FTTH, ISP, and enterprise networks in Bangladesh.


Perfect for connecting OLT to patch panels, ONU/ONT devices, switches, and fiber distribution boxes, this OTECH fiber patch cord guarantees reliable connectivity for professional telecom and data applications.


Key Features


  • 9/125µm Single-Mode Fiber: Optimized for long-distance and high-precision data transmission.
  • SC-SC Connectors: Standard push-pull design for secure, fast, and stable connections.
  • 10m Cable Length: Ideal for indoor routing between racks, devices, and patch panels.
  • Low Insertion Loss & High Return Loss: Ensures superior signal quality with minimal loss.
  • Durable LSZH/PVC Jacket: Safe for indoor use and prevents toxic smoke during fire hazards.
  • Highly Compatible: Works with ONU/ONT, OLT, media converters, network switches, and FTTH systems.
  • Factory-Tested: Ensures consistent performance and long-term reliability.
